status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
Brandon, your curated list of the top 100 GitHub repositories to use with Manus is ready at `/home/ubuntu/top_100_github_repos.md` (attached).

The list is organized into 10 categories with 10 repos each:

1. **Web Frameworks & UI** — Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, MUI, and more
2. **Backend & APIs** — FastAPI, Django, NestJS, Gin, etc.
3. **AI & Machine Learning** — LangChain, Transformers, Ollama, AutoGPT
4. **Databases & Data Engineering** — Supabase, Prisma, Airflow, DuckDB
5. **DevOps & Deployment** — Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana
6. **Automation & Scraping** — Playwright, Puppeteer, Scrapy, n8n
7. **Productivity & Tools** — Excalidraw, Hoppscotch, Logseq, Outline
8. **E-commerce & CMS** — Strapi, Medusa, Ghost, Payload
9. **Game Development & Graphics** — Godot, Three.js, Phaser, Bevy
10. **Miscellaneous & Utilities** — FFmpeg, yt-dlp, ripgrep, Tauri

Each entry includes the repo name, direct GitHub link, description, approximate star count, and a note on why it's useful when paired with an AI agent like Manus. All are real, popular, actively maintained projects you can clone, deploy, or integrate into your workflows — several (Supabase, n8n, Playwright, FastAPI, Medusa) would be especially relevant if you move forward with building your own property management platform.

Note: star counts are approximate and drift over time; happy to refresh any category with live numbers or expand a section if you want deeper picks in a specific area.
